title: Retrieve Provisional Figures Information
description: This endpoint is used to retrieve the provisional figures information recorded for a tax return. A National Insurance number and tax year are required.

submittedOn.description: The date and time the supplementary information was submitted, in the format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ

provisionalFiguresIndicator.description: A boolean indicating whether provisional figures were used.

expectedDate.description: The expected date when the final figures will be available. This date must be in the future. Must conform to the format: YYYY-MM-DD

supplementaryInformation.description: Additional information describing the use of provisional figures. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.
supplementaryInformation.example: Provisional figures used pending final confirmation.
